canonical_data: tenant-managed Microsoft 365 content and permissions plus service-managed chats, notebooks, search context, agent configurations, and generated artifacts
current_repo_note: This record covers the organizational Microsoft 365 Copilot product under commercial licensing; consumer Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Security Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Foundry remain distinct products.
strengths: Work IQ grounds chat, search, notebooks, creation, and agents in organizational context across Microsoft 365 applications
Enterprise search and ready-made or custom agents connect knowledge retrieval with governed business actions
Microsoft 365 permissions, sensitivity labels, retention policies, administration, and commercial data protections provide a strong tenant boundary
weaknesses: The broad Copilot brand and overlapping Chat, Studio, agent, and application surfaces make product boundaries difficult to communicate
Licensing, capabilities, and integrations vary by tenant plan, administrator configuration, application, and region
The service is proprietary, cloud-managed, and deeply coupled to the Microsoft 365 ecosystem
why_it_matters: A leading enterprise assistant reference that combines tenant context, governed search, productivity applications, notebooks, and custom agents within a mature organizational control plane.
